note: Exact reader wording approved by Ralph. No projection changes and no model calls.

cards.public_summary: Albert Breer reported Cleveland chose Deshaun Watson to start after weighing his full spring and training-camp body of work.
cards.evidence: Todd Monken and his staff reviewed Deshaun Watson's full spring and training-camp body of work, decided he was the more consistent option and named him Cleveland's starting quarterback.
cards.commentary: Watson has the job, but not much leash. Breer expects Cleveland to reconsider if the first two games go poorly, leaving Watson as a volatile QB2.
cards.author: Albert Breer

cards.public_summary: Breer reported Cleveland told Shedeur Sanders to play the long game after choosing Watson as its starter.
cards.evidence: After choosing Watson as its starter, Cleveland told Shedeur Sanders to play the long game, keep making progress and not let the decision derail him.
cards.commentary: Sanders’ immediate path is closed, but Cleveland can pivot if Watson struggles. He is a deep superflex stash, not a redraft starter.
cards.author: Albert Breer

cards.public_summary: Breer argued Ashton Jeanty’s ankle injury could delay Fernando Mendoza’s debut because Las Vegas wants a reliable run game supporting its rookie quarterback.
cards.evidence: Albert Breer argued that Ashton Jeanty's ankle injury could affect when Fernando Mendoza gets on the field because the Raiders want an effective run game supporting their young quarterback.
cards.commentary: This is a second-order risk, not a setback to Mendoza himself. His redraft value remains near zero until Las Vegas prepares to start him.
cards.author: Albert Breer

cards.public_summary: Titans On SI noted Will Levis completed 4 of 9 passes for 15 yards and finished behind Mitch Trubisky and Hendon Hooker in the quarterback rotation.
cards.evidence: Will Levis completed 4 of 9 passes for 15 yards, took a sack and was the least effective Titans quarterback, behind Mitch Trubisky and Hendon Hooker.
cards.commentary: Levis is running out of runway in Tennessee. He needs a sharp preseason finale merely to preserve a roster spot, let alone fantasy value.
cards.author: Lane Mills

cards.public_summary: Julius Chestnut led Tennessee’s backs for a second straight week, producing 48 rushing yards and 24 receiving yards while Kalel Mullings was sidelined.
cards.evidence: With Kalel Mullings sidelined by a reported hip pointer, Julius Chestnut led Tennessee's running backs for a second straight week with 48 rushing yards and 24 receiving yards.
cards.commentary: Chestnut is making a legitimate roster case. The performance does not establish a regular-season role, but he is winning the current depth battle.
cards.author: Lane Mills

cards.public_summary: Bryce Oliver caught none of his two targets while Xavier Restrepo produced two receptions in Tennessee’s latest preseason game.
cards.evidence: Bryce Oliver caught none of his two targets while direct position competitor Xavier Restrepo caught two of three targets for 10 yards.
cards.commentary: One quiet game should not decide a roster battle, but Oliver appears to be losing ground in the competition for Tennessee’s sixth receiver spot.
cards.author: Lane Mills

cards.public_summary: Xavier Restrepo caught two of three targets while direct competitor Bryce Oliver went without a reception.
cards.evidence: Xavier Restrepo caught two of three targets for 10 yards while direct position competitor Bryce Oliver went without a reception on two targets.
cards.commentary: Restrepo is beginning to edge ahead for Tennessee’s final receiver spot. It is deep-league information, but the role trend is worth tracking.
cards.author: Lane Mills

cards.public_summary: Mike McCarthy said Pittsburgh has not selected its 53-man roster, pushing back on a report that all four quarterbacks would stay.
cards.evidence: Mike McCarthy said he had not been part of conversations in which Pittsburgh's 53-man roster had already been selected, pushing back on a report that all four quarterbacks would stay.
cards.commentary: Howard remains on the bubble after a poor preseason start. Nothing is final, but he appears to have the most vulnerable spot in the room.
cards.author: Jacob Punturi

cards.public_summary: Steelers On SI says Drew Allar has flashed during the preseason and shown noticeably improved footwork under McCarthy.
cards.evidence: Steelers On SI wrote that Drew Allar has shown flashes in limited preseason reps and that his footwork has looked drastically improved under Mike McCarthy.
cards.commentary: Allar looks like Pittsburgh’s preferred developmental quarterback. That is dynasty-watchlist material, even though Aaron Rodgers blocks his immediate path.
cards.author: Jacob Punturi

cards.public_summary: Kevin Stefanski remained noncommittal about Penix playing Friday despite his clearance for full 11-on-11 work.
cards.evidence: Michael Penix Jr. was cleared to return to full 11-on-11 work, but Kevin Stefanski remained noncommittal about whether Penix would play Friday against Miami.
cards.commentary: Full-team practice remains encouraging, but Penix has not received a game-action green light. His recovery is progressing without settling Atlanta’s Week 1 decision.
cards.author: Darius Hayes

cards.public_summary: Falcons On SI expects Tua Tagovailoa to start Friday while Atlanta evaluates whether Penix is ready to play.
cards.evidence: Falcons On SI wrote that Tua Tagovailoa will likely start Friday while Atlanta determines whether Michael Penix Jr. will be ready to play.
cards.commentary: Another start would give Tua the next opportunity to strengthen his case. This is an informed expectation, not a regular-season starter announcement.
cards.author: Darius Hayes

cards.public_summary: Fantasy On SI relayed that TreVeyon Henderson left practice after slipping during a cut and receiving attention on his right ankle, foot or leg.
cards.evidence: TreVeyon Henderson slipped while trying to make a cut, left practice and did not return while the training staff examined his right ankle, foot or leg; the extent was not yet known.
cards.commentary: The location and severity remain uncertain, so this is monitoring mode rather than panic mode. Any missed time would be especially costly while Henderson fights for touches.
cards.author: Mark Morales-Smith

cards.public_summary: Fantasy On SI projects Stevenson’s workload could rise substantially if Henderson’s injury costs him time.
cards.evidence: Fantasy On SI projected that Rhamondre Stevenson could see his workload rise from roughly 60 percent to around 80 percent if TreVeyon Henderson misses time.
cards.commentary: Stevenson would move from a risky flex toward RB2 territory if Henderson sits. That upgrade remains entirely contingent on the diagnosis.
cards.author: Mark Morales-Smith

cards.public_summary: Fantasy On SI identifies Jam Miller as a dark-horse roster and backfield beneficiary if Henderson misses time.
cards.evidence: Fantasy On SI identified seventh-round rookie Jam Miller as a dark horse to make the 53-man roster and carve out a rushing role if TreVeyon Henderson's injury is serious.
cards.commentary: Miller is still a longshot, but the injury gives the seventh-round rookie a clearer path to surviving cuts and earning reserve touches.
cards.author: Mark Morales-Smith

cards.public_summary: Antwan Staley reported Aaron Glenn expects Hall to be ready for Week 1.
cards.evidence: Breece Hall is moving well. Aaron Glenn anticipates Hall being ready for Week 1.
cards.commentary: That is the clearest reassurance yet; keep Hall’s projection intact while monitoring his return to full practice.
cards.author: Antwan Staley

cards.public_summary: Jeff McLane observed Lemon make a full return to practice and participate in 7-on-7 work.
cards.evidence: Eagles rookie wide receiver Makai Lemon made a full return to practice and participated in 7-on-7 work.
cards.commentary: This is a major step beyond limited receiver drills and puts his early-season role back on track.
cards.author: Jeff McLane

cards.public_summary: EJ Smith observed DeVonta work with the starting offense and make an over-the-middle catch.
cards.evidence: DeVonta Smith worked with the starting offense during 7-on-7s and closed the session with a catch over the middle.
cards.commentary: First-team work is another positive checkpoint following his hamstring limitation.
cards.author: EJ Smith

cards.public_summary: Brandon Lee Gowton observed Wicks open practice with Philadelphia’s starting receivers.
cards.evidence: Philadelphia's starting receivers at Monday's practice were DeVonta Smith, Dontayvion Wicks and Makai Lemon.
cards.commentary: One practice does not lock down a role, but first-team placement makes Wicks substantially more interesting.
cards.author: Brandon Lee Gowton

cards.public_summary: Jeff Zrebiec reported Flowers was not practicing Monday.
cards.evidence: Rasheen Ali was back practicing Monday. Zay Flowers was among the Ravens players Jeff Zrebiec did not see at practice.
cards.commentary: No reason or timetable was supplied, so this is a new availability flag without enough information to change his projection.
cards.author: Jeff Zrebiec

cards.public_summary: Zrebiec observed Ali return to Ravens practice Monday.
cards.evidence: Rasheen Ali was back practicing with the Ravens on Monday.
cards.commentary: The return keeps Ali alive in Baltimore’s reserve-back competition, although no workload was reported.
cards.author: Jeff Zrebiec

cards.public_summary: Sheena Quick reported Hubbard is expected back for Week 1 after reaching 20 mph during return-to-play work.
cards.evidence: Chuba Hubbard is expected to be ready for Week 1 after reaching 20 mph during return-to-play work last week.
cards.commentary: That is strong recovery evidence and reinforces Hubbard as Carolina’s likely opening-week lead back.
cards.author: Sheena Quick

cards.public_summary: Gowton observed McKee take the first QB2 reps during Monday’s 11-on-11 period.
cards.evidence: Tanner McKee was the first quarterback up for Philadelphia's QB2 reps during Monday's 11-on-11 period.
cards.commentary: It is only one practice, but McKee currently appears to have the inside track on Philadelphia’s backup job.
cards.author: Brandon Lee Gowton

cards.public_summary: Zack Blatt observed Sadiq with the Jets offense in a helmet but said he had not participated.
cards.evidence: Kenyon Sadiq was with the Jets offense and had his helmet on during early drills, but he had not participated.
cards.commentary: Seeing him near the offense is encouraging, but this was not a return to practice. His draft price should remain suppressed until team work resumes.
cards.author: Zack Blatt

cards.public_summary: Tony Grossi observed Judkins return to Browns practice Monday.
cards.evidence: Quinshon Judkins was among the Browns players back at practice Monday.
cards.commentary: The return is a useful availability checkpoint; workload and contact participation still need confirmation.
cards.author: Tony Grossi

cards.public_summary: Grossi observed Tillman return to Browns practice Monday.
cards.evidence: Cedric Tillman was among the Browns players back at practice Monday.
cards.commentary: Tillman is moving in the right direction, but the report does not establish how much work he handled.
cards.author: Tony Grossi

cards.public_summary: Eliot Shorr-Parks observed Brown catch a roughly 35-yard pass from Jalen Hurts.
cards.evidence: Jalen Hurts connected with Marquise Brown deep for a gain of roughly 35 yards during practice.
cards.commentary: One deep completion is not a target-share trend, but it is an encouraging example of Brown supplying the vertical element Philadelphia wants.
cards.author: Eliot Shorr-Parks

cards.public_summary: Ryan Wood observed Lloyd lose his first fumble of camp during an inside handoff.
cards.evidence: MarShawn Lloyd fumbled an inside handoff from Jordan Love, and Barryn Sorrell recovered Lloyd's first fumble of camp.
cards.commentary: One exchange mistake will not erase his summer, but ball security matters for a back still earning the staff’s trust.
cards.author: Ryan Wood
